title: POST /api/decks/images/:uid/edit/quote (D1544, #3784)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `imageVary` method passes through: an edit's price before it runs (`routes/deck_image_edits.ts`). Either `ai: true` with the model, one hold for the edit and its three checks, the reference images it sends (each at most 512 by 512) and whether the balance covers it; or `ai: false` with the reason the edit cannot run and the words to show. Nothing is run or held by a quote. D1511 (#3762).
